parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.0 e.command: set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.0 enable
set protocols cfm interface ge-0/0/1.0 e.explanation: 在指定接口上启用CFM（Connectivity Fault Management）协议。

set protocols mpls label-protocol ldp.explanation: 配置MPLS标签分发协议为LDP（Label Distribution Protocol）。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family ethernet-switching vlan-id [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family ethernet-switching vlan-id 1
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family.explanation: 配置接口的以太网交换VLAN ID。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family mpls xconnect [parameter3] [parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1.0 unit 1 family mpls xconnect 2.2.2.2 1001

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family inet address 192.168.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/2 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols mpls interface ge-0/0/2.0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用MPLS协议。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.1/24
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 在指定区域中启用OSPF协议在指定接口上。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/2.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 在指定区域中启用OSPF协议在指定接口上。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1.explanation: 配置CFM的维护域（MD）和维护关联（MA）。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 1 in.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] interface [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 1 in.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 1 interface ge-0/0/1.0
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 1 in.explanation: 配置CFM的维护端点（MEP）及其关联的接口。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 1 cc.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] mep [parameter3] ccm-send [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 1 cc.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 1 ccm-send enable
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 mep 1 cc.explanation: 启用CFM维护端点的CCM（Continuity Check Message）发送功能。

parameters.name: ccm-send
parameters.explanation: CCM发送功能的启用状态，例如enable。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-m.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] remote-mep [parameter3]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-m.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 remote-mep 2

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 ccm-rece.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] ccm-receive mep [parameter3] [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 ccm-rece.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 ccm-receive mep 2 enable
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 ccm-rece.explanation: 启用CFM维护端点的CCM接收功能。

parameters.name: ccm-receive
parameters.explanation: CCM接收功能的启用状态，例如enable。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] test-id [parameter3] source-mep [parameter4] destination-remote-mep [parameter5]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id 1 source-mep 1 destination-remote-mep 2
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id.explanation: 配置CFM的测试ID，指定源MEP和目标RMEP。

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] test-id [parameter3] source-mep [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 test-id 3 source-mep 1

set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 delay-me.template: set protocols cfm md [parameter1] ma [parameter2] delay-measure one-way type [parameter3] test-id [parameter4]
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 delay-me.command: set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 delay-measure one-way type receive test-id 3
set protocols cfm md md1 ma ma1 delay-me.explanation: 配置CFM的单向延迟测量类型和测试ID。
